# Music MCP Server

> Searchable catalog of 100,000+ royalty-free and Creative Commons music tracks with instant attribution formatting.

## Installation
- UVX: `uvx free-music-library-mcp`
- NPX: `npx -y free-music-library-mcp`
- Curl: `curl -fsSL https://music.builditwithai.xyz/install | bash`
- Documentation: https://music.builditwithai.xyz

## Primary Tools
- `search_tracks(query, catalog, limit)`: Searches music tracks.
- `search_by_mood_genre(genre, mood, limit)`: Filters by mood and genre.
- `get_track_details(track_id)`: Retrieves audio streams and duration.
- `get_attribution(track_id)`: Generates copy-paste attribution text.
- `list_catalogs()`: Lists available music catalogs.

## Environment Variables
- `DO_NOT_TRACK`: Set to `1` to disable anonymous telemetry.
